_meta.purpose: The step-by-step instructions a patient or practitioner follows on the day a procedure is performed. One entry per pinned day action the engine schedules.
_meta.why_this_file_exists: None of the 23 rows in panchakarma_therapies.json carried an instructions field, so every how-to in the feature — roughly 500 words of procedural prose covering emesis, purgation, two kinds of enema, nasal instillation and bloodletting — lived as string literals inside panchakarma_engine.py. Prose in code cannot be reviewed as data, cannot be handed to a vaidya as a document, cannot be translated by the i18n layer, and cannot be checked by a test. This is the same state the gym library was in before scripts/gym_library/prose.py.
_meta.review_status: AUTHORED, NOT CLINICALLY REVIEWED. Text was carried across from the engine literals and corrected where the move exposed a defect (noted per entry). Needs BAMS/MD (Ayurveda) sign-off alongside panchakarma_clinical.json.
_meta.templating: `steps` entries may contain {placeholders}. The engine fills them from the selected Aushadha and the Basti course; a test asserts every placeholder in this file is one the engine supplies, because an unfilled placeholder would print a brace to a patient.
sources: Charaka Samhita — Siddhi Sthana 1-2 (Vamana/Virechana Vyapat), Siddhi Sthana 3-12 (Basti)

virechana.name: Virechana — {drug_name}
virechana.benefits: Expels excess Pitta from Pakvashaya (colon). Clears Raktavaha and Pittavaha Srotas.
steps: Take {drug_name} ({dose}) in the evening after a light dinner.
Stay within reach of a toilet — purgation begins in 4–8 hours. Keep warm water available.
Count Vegas (episodes). Samyak Yoga is 5–10 for mild Virechana and 20–30 for a full clinical course; the number is the measure of adequacy, not the volume of the drug.
Stop and seek help at blood in the stool, cramping that does not settle between Vegas, faintness, or Vegas continuing past the expected count — these are Atiyoga.
After completion rest supine; sip warm water if thirsty. Do not eat until the Samsarjana Krama stage for tomorrow.
virechana._step_4_note: The Atiyoga line is new. The engine's version gave the Samyak Yoga counts and no failure signs at all — it told the patient what success looks like and nothing about what going wrong looks like, for a procedure they perform unsupervised at home.

conditional_steps.grishma: Grishma Ritu (summer): Bala is reduced in summer heat — mild dose only. Trivrit Churna is contraindicated in this season; use Eranda or Triphala. Avoid vigorous Swedana on the Virechana day.

vamana.name: Vamana — Therapeutic Emesis
vamana.benefits: Expels accumulated Kapha from Amashaya (stomach). Clears Pranavaha and Annavaha Srotas.
steps: Performed by a qualified Vaidya. Morning, empty stomach, only after Purvakarma is complete and Samyak Snigdha signs are present.
Patient drinks 6–8 glasses of warm milk or sugarcane juice (Akantha Pana) beforehand.
{drug_name} administered — {dose}. {dose_note}
Count Vegas: 8 is Samyak Yoga (adequate purification); the sequence should end with Kapha, then Pitta, then froth.
Atiyoga — more than 12 Vegas, blood in the vomitus, or collapse: stop immediately, give Ghrita with warm milk, and treat as a Vyapat (CS Siddhi Sthana 6).
Complete rest for 24 hours. Dhoomapana and the Samsarjana Krama follow.
vamana._step_3_note: Was 'Madanaphala Phanta administered' — the drug name hardcoded, so the engine printed Madanaphala regardless of which emetic the Bala assessment had selected. It now names the drug that was chosen.

nasya.name: Navana Nasya — {oil_name}
nasya.benefits: Clears Kapha and Vata from Urdhvanga (head, neck, sinuses). Reaches Manovaha Srotas via the Sringataka Marma.
nasya.timing: Morning — 30 min after face Abhyanga and steam
steps: Warm the face with steam or a hot towel for 5 minutes, then massage the forehead, temples and sinuses.
Lie supine with the head tilted back slightly, shoulders supported.
Administer 6–8 drops of {oil_name} into each nostril, sniffing gently upward.
Remain supine for 5 minutes. Spit out any drainage — do not swallow it.
Avoid food, cold water and wind for 30 minutes afterwards. Repeat daily for every day of the Nasya phase.

basti_matra.name: Matra Basti — {oil_name}
basti_matra.benefits: Lubricates Pakwashaya and nourishes Vata-dominant Srotas. The safest home Basti — the oil is absorbed, so no expulsion is forced.
steps: Night, after a light dinner. Empty the bladder and bowels first.
Warm 50–80 ml of {oil_name} to body temperature (38°C) — warm to the wrist, never hot.
Using an enema bulb (Netra), lie on the left side with the right knee drawn up. Administer slowly over 1–2 minutes.
Remain lying down. Retain overnight if possible; the oil is absorbed and no Vega is needed.
If the oil is expelled within an hour on three consecutive nights, or there is pain or bleeding, stop and consult a Vaidya.
Repeat nightly for every day of the Basti phase.
basti_matra._step_5_note: New. The engine's version described only the success case, for a procedure the patient self-administers.

basti_niruha.name: Niruha Basti (Decoction) — {kashayam_name}
basti_niruha.benefits: Vata Shodhana from Pakvashaya — the decoction expels, where the oil days nourish.
basti_niruha.timing: Morning, empty stomach — administered by a Vaidya
steps: {position}. {sequence_note}
Formula ({total_volume}, {temperature}): {kashayam_name} with {oil_name}. Mix in sequence: {mix_order}. The order is not decorative — Madhu and Saindhava are emulsified first, or the Sneha separates.
Patient lies on the left side, right knee drawn up. Netra inserted and the enema given slowly.
Retain 30–60 minutes; expulsion follows naturally. Rest 1–2 hours afterwards.
Light warm food only for the rest of the day — Khichdi, moong dal, warm soup. Nothing cold, heavy, raw or dry.

basti_anuvasana.name: Anuvasana Basti (Oil) — {oil_name}
basti_anuvasana.benefits: Brimhana — nourishes and lubricates Pakwashaya, and protects against the Vata a Niruha day raises.
steps: {position}. {sequence_note}
{anuvasana_formula} — {oil_name}, warmed to body temperature.
Given after food, never before: an empty Koshtha absorbs the oil too fast and the Basti is wasted.
Retain until morning or until the urge to defecate. No expulsion is forced — the oil is absorbed, which is the point of the day.

raktamokshana.name: Raktamokshana — Blood Purification
raktamokshana.benefits: Purifies Rakta Dhatu — removes Pitta-Rakta vitiation from Raktavaha Srotas.
steps: Performed by a qualified Vaidya. Jalaukavacharana (leech therapy) or Shringa (cupping) per indication.
Morning, light stomach. Leeches are applied to the affected site and removed when engorged (20–30 minutes).
Post-procedure: wash the site with Haridra (turmeric) water and dress it. Monitor for 2 hours.
Expect mild oozing for a few hours; bleeding that does not stop, spreading redness, or fever within 48 hours needs immediate review.
Avoid sour and pungent food for 3 days afterwards.
raktamokshana._step_4_note: New. Leech sites ooze by design, which makes it hard for a patient to judge when bleeding has become a problem — so the threshold is stated.

deepana_pachana.name: Deepana-Pachana — {herb_name}
deepana_pachana.benefits: Kindles Agni and digests Ama. Until Ama is digested no other therapy can reach the Dhatus.
steps: {herb_name} on an empty stomach with warm water.
Alternatives if unavailable: {alternatives}.
Diet: {diet}
Ama is cleared when: {signs}.
Do not progress to the next phase before those signs appear — the days below are a guide, not a deadline.

brimhana.name: Brimhana Rasayana — {herb_name}
brimhana.benefits: Rebuilds Dhatu and Ojas. This is the phase that makes a future Shodhana possible.
steps: {herb_name} — {dose}.
Continue for {duration} beyond the end of this plan; Rasayana works over months, not days.
Nourishing food, unhurried meals, sleep before 10pm, and no fasting of any kind.
Re-assess Bala, Agni, Ama and Ojas with a Vaidya before considering Shodhana.

samsarjana.name: Samsarjana Krama — Stage {stage}: {food}
samsarjana.benefits: Rekindles Agni by graded steps. The re-entry is as much of the treatment as the cleanse.
steps: {recipe}
{note}
Move to the next stage only when this one digests comfortably. Rushing Samsarjana is what undoes the Shodhana — Agni is at its weakest now.
samsarjana.final_stage_step: Hold at this stage until normal appetite returns, then resume a Pathya diet.

shamana_regimen._note: The Ahara and Vihara a Shamana plan prescribes per Vikriti. Moved out of _SHAMANA_BY_DOSHA in panchakarma_engine.py: it is dietary and lifestyle instruction given to a patient, which is data, not control flow.

kapha.principle: Ruksha–Ushna–Laghu Shamana — drying, warming, light. Kapha is Guru, Snigdha and Sheeta; it is pacified by dry, warm and light.
kapha.sneha_matra: Shamana-matra Sneha: Kapha needs the least oleation. 5–10 ml Sarshapa Taila (mustard) or Trikatu-infused ghee, or omit internal Sneha entirely and keep only external Udvartana. Never the escalating Snehapana ladder.
kapha.ahara: Warm, dry, light, well-spiced. Barley, millet, steamed greens, ginger, black pepper, honey (never heated). Avoid dairy, wheat, sugar, cold drinks, curd and daytime sleep.
kapha.vihara: Movement is the medicine. Rise before sunrise, brisk walking, dry brushing before bathing, no daytime sleep at all.

pitta.principle: Sheeta–Madhura–Tikta Shamana — cooling, sweet and bitter. Pitta is Ushna, Tikshna and Drava; it is pacified by cool and mild.
pitta.sneha_matra: Shamana-matra Sneha: 10 ml Tikta Ghrita or Shatavari Ghrita with warm water in the morning. A pacifying dose — not the escalating Snehapana ladder, which prepares for an expulsion this plan does not perform.
pitta.ahara: Cool to lukewarm, sweet, bitter and astringent. Rice, coconut, cucumber, coriander, sweet fruit, ghee. Avoid sour, fermented, salty, pungent, chilli, alcohol and the midday sun.
pitta.vihara: Cool the evening, not the day. Moonlight, cool baths, Sheetali pranayama. Avoid arguments, deadlines late at night, and exercise in heat.

vata.principle: Snigdha–Ushna Shamana — unctuous, warm, grounding. Vata is Ruksha, Sheeta and Chala; it is pacified by its opposites.
vata.sneha_matra: Shamana-matra Sneha: 10–15 ml warm Tila Taila or Bala Taila with warm water, once daily before food. A pacifying dose — not the escalating Snehapana ladder, which prepares for an expulsion this plan does not perform.
vata.ahara: Warm, moist, well-cooked, mildly oily. Madhura–Amla–Lavana Rasa. Moong dal khichdi with ghee, root vegetables, warm milk with nutmeg. Avoid raw salads, dried and frozen food, carbonated drinks.
vata.vihara: Regular hours above all. Early sleep, no travel, no fasting, no vigorous exercise. Warm oil to the soles and scalp before bed.
